$schema_comment: Per-source decision cards for external data sources listed in external-source-update-policy.md §4.1. Each card covers one source group, with fields per the execution plan §4.1 requirements. Unknown fields are explicitly marked unknown. Disposition (ALLOW/ALLOW_WITH_OBLIGATIONS/DENY) is left for Human/Ops to decide.

cards.datasets_endpoints: Immediate weather observations, disaster/hazard alerts, forecasts
cards.usage: Real-time weather and alert display for site selection and risk assessment
cards.commercial_scope: unknown — requires confirmation of open data commercial use terms
cards.retention_redistribution: unknown — depends on terms version and data category
cards.attribution: Required per Open Government Data License
cards.quota: unknown — API rate limits to be confirmed with CWA documentation
cards.official_publish_frequency: Varies by dataset: minute-level for observations, event-driven for alerts
